account.error.offline: No connection to the account service. Your game is not affected; try again later.
account.error.invalid-email: That email address is not valid.
account.error.email-unavailable: Emails cannot be sent to that address yet. Your guest account keeps working; try Google instead.
account.error.email-in-use: That email already belongs to another Trail Game account, so it cannot be added to this one. To play that account here, sign in to it instead.
account.error.identity-in-use: That Google account already belongs to another Trail Game account, so it cannot be added to this one. To play that account here, sign in to it instead.
account.error.weak-password: Choose a longer, stronger password (at least 8 characters).
account.error.rate-limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
account.error.linking-disabled: Account linking is not enabled yet. Your guest account keeps working.
account.error.provider-disabled: This sign-in option is not available yet. Your guest account keeps working.
account.error.not-linked: Linking did not finish. Your guest account is unchanged; you can try again.
account.error.cancelled: Linking was cancelled. Your guest account is unchanged.
account.error.different-account: The sign-in returned a different account, so it was not used. Your career on this device is unchanged.
account.error.email-not-confirmed: Confirm your email first: open the link we sent you.
account.error.failed: Something went wrong. Your guest account is unchanged; try again.
account.title: Account
account.unavailable: The account service is not reachable right now. You can keep playing; your career is saved on this device.
account.guestText: Your career is saved on this device. Link an email or a Google account to keep access to your account if you change or lose your phone. It is optional: you can keep playing as a guest.
account.anotherEmail: Use another email, or send the link again
account.protected: Your account and career are protected.
account.passwordSaved: Password saved. You can sign in with your email and password.
account.signInInstead: Sign in to that account instead
account.signedIn: Signed in. Your cloud career is loaded on this device.
account.googleLinked: Google account linked. Your career and progress are unchanged.
account.passwordHint: At least {count} characters. Lets you sign in with your email and password.
account.signInExisting: Sign in to an existing account
account.signInHint: Use the account you linked on another device to play its career here. If this device has a career too, you will choose which one to keep.
conflict.title: Choose your career
conflict.text: This device and your account's cloud save have different careers. Choose the one to keep: it becomes your career on this device and in the cloud, and the other one is replaced. Careers are never mixed.
conflict.serverRemote: Training, races and progress are confirmed by the server, so this device's career cannot replace the cloud career. A copy of it is kept on this device.
conflict.serverNoRemote: Training, races and progress are confirmed by the server, so this device's progress cannot be uploaded. You can start a new career with this runner's name and look.
conflict.startNew: Start a new career with this runner
conflict.damaged: The cloud copy is damaged or from another version of the game and cannot be played.
conflict.failed: Your choice could not be saved (no connection, or the cloud changed). Both careers are unchanged; try again.
account.checkInboxBefore: Check your inbox: we sent a confirmation link to
